package.name: go2_sim
package.description:
Go2 Gazebo Classic simulation URDF.
Provides a standalone go2_sim.urdf.xacro with: - Same frame tree as go2_description (base_footprint, base_link, lidar_link, imu_link) - libgazebo_ros_planar_move plugin: /cmd_vel → TF(odom→base_footprint) + /odom (replaces go2_hw_bridge in simulation; identical Nav2 interface) - Unitree L1 LiDAR GPU ray sensor → /unilidar/cloud (PointCloud2) - IMU sensor → /unilidar/imu (Imu)
Portability (TODO(agibot)): Create agibot_d1_sim/ mirroring this package with d1_sim.urdf.xacro. The sensor macro lives in sensor_models/ and is reused unchanged. Zero changes required in robot_nav/ or robot_sim/.
